resolvedOther.resolution: Expanded to 100 operations with closed operation-specific writes, resource and cursor responses, 202 Run responses, SSE realtime, workload mTLS and resolvable path parameters.

Defined 118 closed versioned event payloads, schema-valid deterministic upcaster fixtures and explicit recovery-critical claim, route, focus, lease, effect, workspace, approval, usage and Repair fields.
Replaced generic payload tables with 90 domain tables, typed columns, foreign keys, unique/check constraints, forced RLS, append-only triggers and executable PostgreSQL verification.

Added a CAS-versioned active_tenant_id to each session, an immutable tenant foreign key, an authenticated switch operation and an event so the Gateway never trusts a client-supplied tenant or selects an arbitrary membership.

Added a restricted, expiring idempotency response fact keyed by tenant, user, operation and hashed idempotency key, with request/response hashes and encrypted payload reference for same-transaction replay.
Added a database-enforced unique boundary on tenant, aggregate kind, aggregate id and aggregate version so concurrent writers cannot commit the same aggregate version twice.
